reference.product: Native Instruments Traktor DJ for iPad 1.x

centrality: Required performer feature. Its background work remains secondary to combined audio output and live musical control.

original_behaviour_required: Genre contributes to suggestions as reported
Previous mixes and track combinations contribute as reported
Rankings adapt with use as observed
performer_report.historical_scope: Retained original report; implementation ranking follows performer_policy_2026_10_25, which supersedes independent genre weighting.

NI_launch_claim.claim_scope: NI announcement reproduced by Rekkerd. Capability declaration, not an algorithm disclosure or installed-build measurement.

original_journey: Receive the original ordered candidates from the available collection.
Choose and load through the original workflow.
Continue mixing, preserving the reported history contribution to later rankings.
null_policy_meaning: Unrecovered original detail. Null is not disabled, false, a default or permission to choose a new rule.
do_not_infer: A genre label is a timbre descriptor.
Track properties alone reproduce the observed adaptive rankings.
Every load, preview or recorded mix is a learning event.
Transitions are symmetric or learning is immediate.
Total play counts alone explain adaptive ordering.
Exported XML tracklists are the recommendation training store.
Historical launch behaviour equals every detail of installed 1.6.8.

existing_history_evidence.observation: Existing copied tracklists contain names, artists, opaque identifiers and start-time values.

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: A familiar reference track and its expected next-track suggestions
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Ranked track identities, library snapshot, visible context, settings and build

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: A pair or sequence whose recommendation position changed after repeated mixing
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: The performer's account and any before/after output with history provenance

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: Similar BPM with different keys, then related keys at different BPM
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Original candidates and indicators; do not invent compatibility thresholds

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: Same reference under different current performance tempos
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Original ordering and eligibility changes, if any

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: Similar tempo/key with different genre and sonic character
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Separate observations for genre and timbre; no assumption that one represents the other

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: One deck playing, both playing, then a stopped reference deck
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Which context the original uses and how the view reacts

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: Load or preview a track without actually mixing it
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Whether the original changes history or later suggestions

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: A completed mix, ordinary restart and later return to the same reference
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Update timing and persistence of observed adaptation

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: A corrected BPM, key or grid before reopening suggestions
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Which corrected properties affect the original results

reference_comparison_cases.comparison: A repeated track or a different edit of the same recording
reference_comparison_cases.evidence_to_retain: Identity, recent-use and duplicate behaviour as the original exhibits it

completion_rule: Match agreed original access, candidates, order, feedback, history-dependent adaptation and persistence under the same retained reference context. Appealing replacement recommendations are insufficient.

named_diagnostic_authorisation_2026_10_2.name: GenErik
named_diagnostic_authorisation_2026_10_2.scope: Separate audio-check app installation and one-minute/five-minute performance checks

performer_policy_2026_10_25.source: direct user instructions in current chat
implementation_limits: Key relation tiers and energy estimator remain implementation choices
performer_policy_2026_10_25.previous_pairing_strength: boolean prior pairing, not play-count weighting

implementation_review_2026_10_30.scope: Original requirements and observations are retained. Current implementation is tracked separately; an unresolved original policy is not an absent feature.
